title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
description: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
description: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
description: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

title: Open source and on device: the strategy behind Nvidia’s new AI models
description: The new Nemotron 3.5 models show how the AI giant is focusing on reinforcing its own GPU infrastructure while supporting the open source community.

title: Prompt: Enterprise controls can't keep up with AI agents
description: Companies are giving agents more authority, but many are still struggling to track what they can access, what they're doing and how to stop them.

title: Robots can't talk to each other yet -- that's a big AI bottleneck
description: Coordinating robots and autonomous systems will be critical to unlocking physical AI, but it’s still unclear whether interoperability is an immediate barrier to adoption.

title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
description: Introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and tools to advance life sciences research.

title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
description: Celebrate Teachers’ Day with AI for Educators in Brazilian Portuguese and see how Study Mode can help teachers support active, step-by-step learning.

title: Tracking AI Overviews: What the data actually shows
description: AI Overviews have shifted how audiences discover brands. Gone are the days when users would click through multiple search results until they found what they’re looking for. Now, AI Overviews answers questions directly on the results page, meaning brands are either cited or ignored without users ever visiting a website.

title: Claude skills vs. plugins vs. MCP connectors: A simple guide
description: If you’ve opened Claude’s Customize settings and weren’t sure whether a task called for a Skill, a connector, or a Plugin, you’re not alone.

title: Crossing the Threshold: How OpenAI and Anthropic Approach Autonomy and Safety in Financial Agents
description: At AI Engineer New York, frontier labs and financial firms explored how to give agents useful autonomy while keeping consequential decisions under control.

title: Lab-in-the-Loop at Compute Speed — Ian Quigley, Leash Bio
description: How Leash Bio tamed DELs, the assay that traumatizes everyone, and used the data to catch cheating models. And why that same data is perfect for AI agents learning to think like chemists.

title: 5 Tips To Train Your AI Tools: Get Rid of Those Hallucinations
description: Put your AI tools in the ring with these tips on training against hallucinations.

title: IBM: Agentic AI is reshaping governance, controls and trust
description: As AI agents move from answering questions to making decisions and acting, businesses face a growing challenge of keeping accountability in step with the pace of change.

title: Can we change an AI model’s architecture without retraining it from scratch?
description: “Priming” reuses pretrained Transformer weights to build models with more efficient architectures at less than 1% of the original training cost and with throughputs up to twice as high.
